description: Consume UOGTO costing semantics and the standards_check source catalogue to produce evidence-linked, conditionally applicable reporting coverage from Dapane run bundles.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/UOGTO: costing-valuation applied pack, SHACL, explicit HTA bridge and reporting-profile semantics; qualify a pinned revision.
edithatogo/standards_check: original reporting instrument catalogue, verified item IDs and extraction qualifications; qualify the matching source revision.
completion_evidence: The importer/exporter records exact upstream source versions and checks source content/counts where supported.
Original instrument/version/item IDs and extraction qualifications survive export; project profiles do not claim universal endorsement.
Reported requirements cite evidence; not-applicable assertions carry rationales; partial, missing, unassessed and unresolved states remain distinguishable.
Protocols/reviews are evidence artefacts, not silently promoted into operational reporting checklists.
SHACL conformance is not described as methodological correctness, truth of sources or empirical validity.
Static valuation and the minimal Rust build remain usable without an RDF reasoner or reporting dependency.
